definitions.explanation: A person who has the right to vote in elections. In Japan, all citizens aged 18 and older have the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投票率|とうひょうりつ}→投票率：22200_touhyouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧。
⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}えた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: The candidate appealed for support from voters.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{選挙区|せんきょく}→選挙区：15097_senkyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧10{万人|まんにん}⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are approximately 100,000 eligible voters in this electoral district.

notes:
{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ} literally means "person who has rights" — specifically, the right to vote. Composed of {有|ゆう} (have) + {権|けん} (right) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: number of eligible voters
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: voter awareness
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the voice of voters
- {有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to appeal to voters

USAGE:
The voting age in Japan was lowered from 20 to 18 in 2016. This is a formal, news-oriented term used in political and electoral contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{選挙権|せんきょけん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧: the right to vote (suffrage)
- {投票者|とうひょうしゃ}: a person who actually voted
